admissionFirewall.atlasMay: emit bounded proposal-review eligibility/disposition plus evidence refs
atlasMayNot: infer project priority from region size or zero-touch status
merge heterogeneous strata into one project for symmetry

G0_SCOPE_COHERENCE.question: Is there a bounded problem family coherent enough to investigate as one programme rather than merely a navigation region?

G1_EXISTING_OWNER_NONABSORPTION.question: Has at least one plausible existing-owner extension been tested and rejected or bounded by current owner authority?

G2_NON_DUPLICATION.question: Would the proposed programme own a semantic responsibility not already owned by an existing current owner?

G3_EVIDENCE_OR_FRONTIER_BASIS.question: Is there either a coherent residual/falsifier corpus or an explicitly documented known-unworked frontier sufficient to motivate bounded investigation?

G4_FALSIFIABLE_CHARTER.question: Can the proposal state questions, rivals, negative routes and closeout conditions without pre-admitting a new owner or Foundation?

G5_TRACTABILITY.question: Are suitable public/source-fenced evidence and bounded investigation routes plausibly available?

G6_OWNER_ADMISSION_FIREWALL.question: Does the proposal explicitly state that project approval does not establish semantic owner admission?

purpose: Route Atlas owner-gap findings into an independent project-proposal review without allowing Atlas frontier structure to auto-create projects, owners, Foundations, repositories or roadmaps.
